pack.notes: DRAFT for review: the hotel opening, rooms 70 to 73, where a new game starts. Hand survey by Claude Code on 14 Nov 2026 from the engine's own A11Y state line (engine/queen layer, survey-only room jumps) and one window capture per room. Only objects the engine reports as visible at the start are listed. Queen has no chapters; chapter 1 is a placeholder so the v1 schema validates (the engine layer also reports chapter 1). Hotspot keys are the room-relative object numbers in the A11Y state line. Replaces the 12 Nov draft of the plane rooms 1 to 5, which come later in the story. Milestones cover the room 70 escape only, played through natively by Claude Code on 14 Nov (pick up both sheets, use 52 on 51, use 53 on 14, use 14). Later goals aren't played yet, so rooms 71 to 73 have no hints.

70.name: Locked room upstairs
70.short: A small room with a heavy metal door on the left. A chest stands in the middle, red stage curtains hang behind you, and a window and radiator are on the right. Sheets lie on the floor.
70.long: A small, dim room with purple walls. On the left is a heavy door studded with metal, and a black trunk sits in the bottom left corner. Magic show posters hang on the back wall above a chair and a small table. A purple chest stands in the middle. Behind it, red stage curtains with a gold star hang across the back right. On the right, a cord hangs beside a tall window, with a radiator under it. A pile of sheets lies across the floor at the front.
70.note: Engine room code D1. The first playable room after the intro. No exit at the start: the door (13) is locked, and the way out is a puzzle with the sheets, radiator and a laundry chute hidden under a sheet (objects 5, 6, 7, 18 and 20 are hidden until then). The posters, chest and trunk belong to the Great Markam (look lines). Anderson (21) is hidden at the start. Room name is mine. Hotspots 8 and 11 (the sheets) have no pack entry on purpose: once the rope is tied the engine renames 8 to 'laundry chute' and 11 to 'radiator with sheet rope', and a pack name can't follow that, so the engine's names are spoken.

71.name: Prop store
71.short: A cluttered prop store below. Shelves of stage props stand in the middle, spiral stairs climb on the left, and a sheet rope hangs down from a chute in the top left corner.
71.long: A cluttered storeroom under the stage, with wooden beams and cobwebs. A sheet rope hangs from a laundry chute in the top left corner, down to a pile of sheets on the floor. Spiral stairs climb up on the left. In the middle, a tall set of shelves is full of props: masks, cocktail umbrellas, rubber swords and tools, and a box of crowbars on top. A wheeled ladder leans against the shelves on their right. Up on the right, a doorway glows red.
71.note: Engine room code D2. Reached from room 70 down the sheet rope. Door 4 (to Lola's dressing room, 72) is hidden at the start, so it's not listed as an exit yet. Door 3 is the doorway at the top right where you arrive; it has no exit target. The props are rubber (look lines). Room name is mine.

72.name: Lola's dressing room
72.short: Lola's dressing room. A rack of costumes is on the left, a lit mirror over a dressing table in the middle where Lola sits, and a bed at the front.
72.long: A dressing room under two hanging lamps. On the left, a big rack of feathered costumes. The doorway you came in by is behind it, at the back. A poster of Lola hangs on the back wall beside a black chest. In the middle, a mirror ringed with bulbs hangs over a dressing table, with LOLA loves RICO written on the glass. Lola sits at the table in a green dress. A bin stands to her right, and a tall cupboard fills the right edge. At the front is the end of a bed, with a teddy bear and a pair of handcuffs on it.
72.note: Engine room code D3. 'LOLA loves RICO' is read from the capture (a heart between the names). Lola has a second, hidden object (6). Room name from look lines ('Lola's personal stuff').

73.name: Hotel lobby
73.short: The hotel lobby. Glass doors to the street are on the left, two men in suits stand in the middle, and a bellboy waits behind the front desk on the right.
73.long: A grand lobby with marble pillars and purple walls. On the left, tall glass doors look out on a sunny street, with a truck parked outside. Two of Anderson's men stand in front of them: Rico, tall in a blue suit, and Eddy, shorter in a black suit. A sign for Lola's show stands beside a potted plant. At the back, right of centre, a dark doorway leads down to the prop store. On the right, a bellboy in red stands behind the front desk, with a key on the desk.
73.note: Engine room code D4. The glass front doors are not an exit at the start. The sign's hotspot (3, 'dummy') is hidden at the start. Rico and Eddy are 'Anderson's goons' (look lines). Room name is mine.

milestones.title: Made a sheet rope
milestones.recap: You knotted the two lots of sheets into a long sheet rope.

hints.nudge: The door won't budge. Look at what's lying around the room instead.
hints.clue: There are two lots of sheets, a pile at the front and more by the radiator. One on its own is too short.
hints.answer: Pick up both lots of sheets, then use the sheet on the other sheet.

milestones.title: Tied the rope to the radiator
milestones.recap: You tied the sheet rope to the radiator, and found a laundry chute where the sheets had been.

hints.nudge: A rope's only any use with one end fixed to something solid.
hints.clue: The radiator on the right is bolted firmly to the wall.
hints.answer: Use the sheet rope on the radiator.

milestones.title: Climbed down out of the locked room
milestones.recap: You climbed down the sheet rope, through the laundry chute, into the prop store below.

hints.nudge: The rope's tied. Now it needs climbing.
hints.clue: With the sheets moved, there's a laundry chute in the floor, and the rope hangs down it from the radiator.
hints.answer: Use the radiator with the sheet rope to climb down.
